_doc.mode: Mode selected when the page opens: wait (the needle waits for you) or live (the needle moves on a clock).
_doc.hands: Hands selected when the page opens: both, right (top staff) or left (lower staves).
_doc.loop: Loop selected when the page opens: true repeats the piece or the selected bars until you press Stop.
_doc.followRepeats: true follows repeat signs and 1st/2nd endings (the needle jumps back); false plays the bars once as written.
_doc.followJumps: true follows D.C., D.S., Segno, To Coda, Coda and Fine (after a D.C. or D.S. the music ends at Fine or goes on at the Coda); false ignores them and plays repeats only.
_doc.repeatsAfterJump: true plays repeat signs again after a D.C. or D.S.; false (the usual rule) plays each repeated part once after the jump, taking the last ending.
_doc.tempo.percent: Tempo when the page opens, in percent of the written tempo.
_doc.tempo.minPercent: Lowest value of the tempo slider (percent).
_doc.tempo.maxPercent: Highest value of the tempo slider (percent).
_doc.tempo.fallbackBpm: Written tempo (quarter notes per minute) used when the score has none.
_doc.tempo.followChanges: true follows tempo changes inside the piece (metronome marks and sound tempo; a change counts from the start of its bar; rit. and accel. are ignored); false keeps the starting tempo. The Tempo slider scales every tempo.
_doc.ramp.enabled: Ramp toggle when the page opens: true speeds the loop up after each clean run. Ramp only acts when Loop is on.
_doc.ramp.stepPercent: Ramp: percent added to the tempo after each clean loop (no wrong and no missed notes; timing is not judged), and taken off again after backAfterBad bad loops in a row.
_doc.ramp.targetPercent: Ramp: tempo (percent of the written tempo) where the speed-up stops; the loop goes on at this tempo and the status says Target reached. A drill link's target= overrides it; it is capped at tempo.maxPercent.
_doc.ramp.backAfterBad: Ramp: after this many bad loops in a row (a wrong or missed note) the tempo goes back one step, never below the starting tempo (0 = never step back).
_doc.live.windowMs: Live mode: a key press counts for a note only within this many ms before or after the note's time; outside it the press is wrong, and a note not played within it is missed.
_doc.live.onTimeMs: Live mode: within this many ms the note is on time (green); between this and windowMs it is early or late (orange).
_doc.live.needleSlide: Live mode: true slides the needle smoothly between notes, false jumps from note to note.
_doc.timing.perfectMs: Timing score: a note this many ms or less off the beat scores 100. Live mode measures against the clock; wait mode measures the gap from the previous note against the written gap at the Tempo slider pace. The windows above stay fixed; this score is how progress shows.
_doc.timing.zeroMs: Timing score: a note this many ms or more off the beat scores 0 (must be larger than perfectMs).
_doc.timing.curve: Timing score: shape of the drop from 100 to 0 between perfectMs and zeroMs. 1 is a straight line, above 1 is kinder to small offsets, below 1 is stricter.
_doc.timing.redScore: Score colour (live mode; wait mode paints hits plain green): notes scoring this or less are red; above it the colour moves through yellow towards green.
_doc.timing.greenScore: Score colour: notes scoring this or more are green (must be larger than redScore).
_doc.countIn.bars: Live mode: bars of count-in before the first note (0 = none).
_doc.countIn.click: Live mode: true plays the count-in clicks (the count-in wait is kept when false).
_doc.countIn.volume: Volume of the count-in clicks, 0 to 1.
_doc.holds.live: Live mode: true checks that long notes are held; a note released too early gets a short mark.
_doc.holds.wait: Wait mode: true also checks held notes, measured at the Tempo slider pace (the needle still moves on as soon as you press).
_doc.holds.minPercent: A checked note is short when it is released before this percent of its written length.
_doc.holds.minNoteMs: Only notes at least this many ms long (written length at the current tempo) are checked.
_doc.holds.pedal: true: a note released while the sustain pedal is down counts as held.
_doc.holds.staccatoMaxPercent: A staccato note (dot) is not checked for being short; it gets a long mark when its key is held past this percent of its written length (the pedal does not help).
_doc.autoplay.enabled: Auto-play toggle when the page opens: true plays the score for you when you press Follow.
_doc.autoplay.sound: true lets you hear auto-play through the browser (a simple tone); false is silent.
_doc.autoplay.volume: Volume of the auto-play tone, 0 to 1.
_doc.autoplay.gatePercent: How long auto-play holds each note, in percent of the note's written length (the time to the next note if unknown).
_doc.autoplay.staccatoGatePercent: How long auto-play holds a staccato note (dot), in percent of its written length.
_doc.autoplay.waitLeadMs: Wait mode: pause in ms before auto-play plays the first note.
_doc.autoplay.offsetMs: Test knob: auto-play plays every note this many ms late (positive) or early (negative).
_doc.autoplay.jitterMs: Test knob: random timing error per note, up to this many ms early or late (0 = exact).
_doc.autoplay.skipEvery: Test knob: skip every Nth note so it is missed (0 = never). In wait mode a skipped note makes the follower wait there.
_doc.autoplay.wrongEvery: Test knob: add a wrong note (a semitone above) on every Nth note (0 = never).
_doc.autoplay.seed: Test knob: seed for the random jitter, so a run can be repeated exactly.
_doc.autoplay.shortEvery: Test knob: release the notes of every Nth step after 20% of their written length, so they count as short (0 = never).
_doc.view.scrollMarginPx: Space in pixels kept above the current line when the score scrolls to follow.
_doc.view.zoomRedrawMs: Wait this many ms after the last zoom click before the score is redrawn, so quick clicks add up (0 = redraw at once).
